description: This file contains the implementation of the Atheros AR71xx built-in ethernet MAC driver, including functions for configuring network hardware registers using device tree properties and setting up different global MAC configurations based on hardware compatibility.

methods.name: void ag71xx_of_set(struct device_node * np,const char * prop,u32 * reg,u32 shift,u32 mask)
methods.description: Sets a register value based on device tree property, applying shift and mask adjustments.

methods.name: void ag71xx_of_bit(struct device_node * np,const char * prop,u32 * reg,u32 mask)
methods.description: Sets or clears bits in a register based on a boolean device tree property.

methods.name: void ag71xx_setup_gmac_933x(struct device_node * np,void __iomem * base)
methods.description: Configures GMAC registers specific to AR933X hardware based on device tree settings.

methods.name: void ag71xx_setup_gmac_934x(struct device_node * np,void __iomem * base)
methods.description: Configures GMAC registers specific to AR934X hardware based on device tree settings.

methods.name: void ag71xx_setup_gmac_955x(struct device_node * np,void __iomem * base)

methods.name: void ag71xx_setup_gmac_956x(struct device_node * np,void __iomem * base)
methods.description: Configures GMAC registers specific to QCA956X hardware based on device tree settings.

methods.name: int ag71xx_setup_gmac(struct device_node * np)
methods.description: Main function to setup GMAC configuration, selecting the appropriate setup method based on hardware compatibility.
